name: Harold
source:
"May God's blessings be with you."

Nationality: Hathor

During an undercover investigation at a noble-only party in the Nation of Water, Tefnut, Haesu and Dallae come across a striking figure—an enigmatic host. 

While all others conceal their faces with identical masks—preserving the anonymity demanded by the occasion—one woman defies the code. She wears an animal mask from Hathor, the Nation of Fire. A goat, no less—a symbol long entwined with danger and darkness.
Her presence is elegant, refined... and entirely wrong.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/yuri-eclipse/yuri-x-manga-x-visual-noveleclipse/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
